subject: PoC trial plan & deployment mode - Acme Corp
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Max Liu <max.liu@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: PoC trial plan & deployment mode - Acme Corp

Hi Max —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we have alignment. High-level notes:

- Primary business goal: improve customer search relevance and classification latency for ACME web and mobile experiences.
- Technical constraints: bursty traffic with 95th percentile latency targets, and requirement for data isolation for PII.
- Deployment modes discussed: Hosted API (fastest to ship), Dedicated capacity (predictable throughput + data isolation), Private (VPC/on-prem) for regulated workflows.

Recommended PoC approach (attached): Redwood Dedicated trial for 4–6 weeks to validate latency and throughput under realistic load, with a fallback plan to test Hosted for integration speed if provisioning takes longer. Key success criteria (proposed):
  1) P95 latency for 512-token queries <= 120ms across peak traffic windows
  2) Sustained throughput to support 200 concurrent user requests (avg 1.5 req/s)
  3) Output quality retention: no more than 5% regression on top-3 ranking metrics vs current baseline
  4) Clear cost estimate for steady-state (tokens/month) and projected unit cost improvements with batching/caching

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (next 1–2 weeks): sign trial agreement + initial infra access and credentials
- Week 1: Dedicated capacity provisioning + baseline integration (staging)
- Weeks 2–4: Load tests, latency profiling, quality evaluation on sample prompts
- Week 5–6: Final evaluation, cost analysis, rollout recommendations

Next steps for you: please confirm the primary deployment preference (Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private) and the stakeholders we should loop in (CTO/infra/security/procurement). I attached a short PoC trial plan and SLA/Deployment options sheet.

Attachments: Redwood_PoC_TrialPlan_v1.pdf, SLA_Deployment_Options.xlsx

Happy to schedule a 30-minute kickoff next week — propose Wed 7/8 or Thu 7/9.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Max Liu <max.liu@acme-corp.com>

Cc: Sofia Ramirez <s.ramirez@acme.com>, Rajesh Patel <r.patel@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 02:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: PoC trial plan & deployment mode - Acme Corp

Ben —

Thanks for the clear recap and plan. Quick responses inline:

- Deployment preference: Dedicated capacity looks like the best fit for us given the latency targets and requirement to isolate PII-processing. We may evaluate Private for a future phase but want to validate Dedicated throughput first.
- Timeline: the team is targeting a kickoff the week of July 11. 4–6 week PoC sounds good.
- Stakeholders to loop in: Rajesh (CTO) for architecture approval, Sofia (Head of Infra) for provisioning and VPC/network requirements, Procurement will be cc'd once we confirm costs.
- Success criteria: agree on P95 <=120ms target. Also add SLA for uptime during testing and a short runbook for failover to Hosted if capacity issues occur.

Can you also send:
1) Dedicated capacity pricing for a 6-week trial and monthly estimate for steady-state (incl. burst pricing)
2) SOC2 evidence and any security questionnaires we need to fill out (we'll run this with Security)
3) A short tasks list for our infra team so Sofia can provision network/peering/VPN access ahead of the kickoff

Appreciate the attachments. Confirming Wed 7/8 and Thu 7/9 are rough for us; smaller preference for week of 7/11 to align with Sofia's availability.

-Max

Proposed kickoff: Tue, July 13 at 16:00 PT — would that work for Sofia and Rajesh? If not, we can do week of July 11 as Max suggested.

Will set up a short kickoff invite when we hear final availability.

Best,
Ben
